onboarding.layout: Full-height image background with a bottom sheet style card for the login flow.
onboarding.details: Use abstract terracotta background. Clear H1 'Discover. Save. Taste.'. Email input, primary CTA 'Continue'. OTP screen uses 4 large digit boxes.

home_dashboard.layout: Scrollable feed. Sticky header with greeting and profile avatar.
home_dashboard.details: Horizontal scrolling bento cards for 'Stats' (Saved Places, Recipes). Section for 'Recently Added'. Search bar fixed below header.

saved_places.layout: Grid/List toggle. Default to vertical list of large cards.
saved_places.details: Image takes 60% of card height. Source badge (e.g. Instagram icon) overlapping image. Bold title, subtle cuisine tags. Action buttons: Navigate (Google Maps) and Order (Swiggy).

saved_recipes.layout: Vertical scroll. Cards with side-by-side layout on larger screens, stacked on mobile.
saved_recipes.details: Focus on the finished dish image. Show prep time and ingredients count. Primary CTA: 'Order Ingredients (Swiggy)'.

items_to_order.details: Small square thumbnail, item name, restaurant name. Right-aligned price and 'Order' pill button.

share_handler_flow.layout: Modal / Bottom sheet overlaying the current context.
share_handler_flow.details: 1. Scanning state: pulsing animation over image thumbnail. 2. Confirmation state: editable fields for Category (Place/Recipe), Name, Location. 3. Success state with green checkmark.

detail_view.layout: Parallax hero image. Content slides up over the image.
detail_view.details: Massive H1 for the place/recipe name. Content divided into 'About', 'What to get', 'Location'. Floating action bar at the bottom with main CTAs.

micro_interactions.buttons: Scale down slightly (scale-95) on active/press. Smooth bg color transition.
micro_interactions.cards: Subtle Y-axis translation and shadow expansion on hover.
micro_interactions.page_transitions: Slide up and fade in for new screens. Bottom sheets slide from bottom.
micro_interactions.loading: Use skeleton screens with a soft wave animation in the #F3EFEA color. Avoid generic spinners.
micro_interactions.save_action: Heart icon performs a quick pop/scale bounce when filled.

icons.style: stroke-width 2, rounded caps and joins. Avoid filled icons except for active tab or favorite state.

recommendations.swiggy: Use an orange ShoppingBag or generic delivery icon with 'Swiggy' text

hero_backgrounds.description: Warm terracotta texture for the onboarding screen background

restaurant_places.description: Cozy aesthetic cafe interior with plants

recipes_food.description: Delicious penne pasta with creamy cheese sauce

empty_states.description: Cracked terracotta texture to use as a mask or subtle background for empty state illustrations

empty_and_loading_states.empty: Do not just show text. Use a large, soft-edged icon (e.g., Plate or ChefHat) in the secondary color (#7A8B76), accompanied by a friendly, encouraging message like 'Your vault is empty. Time to go hunting.'
empty_and_loading_states.loading: Use the 'Pulse' effect on grey blocks (#F3EFEA). For the AI extraction screen, use a shimmering gradient overlay that traces the image borders.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the exact color hex codes provided. DO NOT use default Tailwind colors like slate or blue.
Headings must use 'Cabinet Grotesk'. Use tracking-tight for all headings above 24px.
Implement the 'generous spacing' rule. If you think p-4 is enough, use p-6 or p-8.
No pure black backgrounds or text. Use the #1A1714 defined in text_primary.
Avoid the generic card component look. Use flat surfaces with large rounded corners (rounded-3xl) and very soft ambient shadows.
For the Swiggy integration buttons, use the primary color (#E05D3A) and a shopping bag icon.
Ensure all user-uploaded content (thumbnails) have a subtle dark gradient overlay at the bottom if text is placed on them.
Since this is a mobile app UI, heavily use bottom sheets (fixed bottom div with border-top-radius) for filters and sharing flows.
